title: icrl:with:professionals,treatments
user_question: I want to know which professionals have received the highest treatment costs for dogs and what their names are.
ideal_sql: WITH TreatmentCosts AS (SELECT `professional_id`, SUM(`cost_of_treatment`) AS total_cost FROM `treatments` GROUP BY `professional_id`) SELECT `p`.`first_name`, `p`.`last_name`, `tc`.`total_cost` FROM `professionals` AS `p` JOIN `TreatmentCosts` AS `tc` ON `p`.`professional_id` = `tc`.`professional_id` ORDER BY `tc`.`total_cost` DESC LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:professionals,treatments
user_question: I want to know which professionals have performed the highest number of treatments for dogs and what their names are.
ideal_sql: WITH treatment_counts AS (SELECT `professional_id`, COUNT(*) AS `treatment_count` FROM `treatments` GROUP BY `professional_id`) SELECT `p`.`first_name`, `p`.`last_name`, `tc`.`treatment_count` FROM `professionals` AS `p` JOIN `treatment_counts` AS `tc` ON `p`.`professional_id` = `tc`.`professional_id` ORDER BY `tc`.`treatment_count` DESC LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:treatment_types,treatments
user_question: I want to know what the average treatment costs are for each type of treatment and which types of treatments have been performed the most.
ideal_sql: WITH treatment_costs AS (SELECT `treatment_type_code`, AVG(`cost_of_treatment`) AS avg_cost FROM `treatments` GROUP BY `treatment_type_code`) SELECT `tt`.`treatment_type_description`, `tc`.`avg_cost` FROM `treatment_types` AS `tt` JOIN treatment_costs AS `tc` ON `tt`.`treatment_type_code` = `tc`.`treatment_type_code` LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:professionals,treatments
user_question: I want to know what types of treatments have been performed on dogs and what the average treatment cost for each type of treatment is.
ideal_sql: WITH treatment_summary AS (SELECT `treatment_type_code`, AVG(`cost_of_treatment`) AS avg_cost FROM `treatments` GROUP BY `treatment_type_code`) SELECT `treatment_type_code`, avg_cost FROM treatment_summary LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:dogs,treatments
user_question: I want to know what the average age of dogs that have received vaccination treatments is and how many of these dogs there are.
ideal_sql: WITH vaccinated_dogs AS (SELECT `dogs`.`age` FROM `dogs` JOIN `treatments` ON `dogs`.`dog_id` = `treatments`.`dog_id` WHERE `treatments`.`treatment_type_code` = 'VAC') SELECT AVG(`age`) AS average_age, COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM vaccinated_dogs LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:owners,professionals,treatments
user_question: With an intermediate question, how many rows are there in the connection between 'owners' and 'professionals'?
ideal_sql: WITH linked AS (SELECT 1 AS x FROM owners JOIN professionals ON owners.cell_number = professionals.cell_number) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM linked

ideal_sql: WITH `concerts_with_theme` AS (SELECT `concert_ID` FROM `concert` WHERE `Theme` = 'Bleeding Love' AND `Year` = 2015) SELECT DISTINCT `singer_in_concert`.`Singer_ID` FROM `singer_in_concert` JOIN `concerts_with_theme` ON `singer_in_concert`.`concert_ID` = `concerts_with_theme`.`concert_ID` LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:concert,singer_in_concert
user_question: How many singers participated in 'Super bootcamp' concerts in 2014?
ideal_sql: WITH concert_singers AS (SELECT `singer_in_concert`.Singer_ID FROM `singer_in_concert` JOIN `concert` ON `singer_in_concert`.concert_ID = `concert`.concert_ID WHERE `concert`.concert_Name = 'Super bootcamp' AND `concert`.Year = 2014) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM concert_singers LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:concert,singer_in_concert,singer
user_question: Which singers performed in concerts in 2014 with the theme 'Free choice'?
ideal_sql: WITH concert_info AS (SELECT `concert_ID` FROM `concert` WHERE `Year` = 2014 AND `Theme` = 'Free choice') SELECT `singer`.`Name`, `singer`.`Country` FROM `singer` JOIN `singer_in_concert` ON `singer`.`Singer_ID` = `singer_in_concert`.`Singer_ID` JOIN concert_info ON `singer_in_concert`.`concert_ID` = concert_info.`concert_ID` LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:concert,stadium
user_question: Which stadiums hosted concerts in 2015 with a capacity of over 5000?
ideal_sql: WITH `concerts_in_2015` AS (SELECT * FROM `concert` WHERE `Year` = 2015) SELECT DISTINCT `stadium`.`Name`, `stadium`.`Location` FROM `stadium` JOIN `concerts_in_2015` ON `stadium`.`Stadium_ID` = `concerts_in_2015`.`Stadium_ID` WHERE `stadium`.`Capacity` > 5000 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:singer,singer_in_concert
user_question: Which singers performed in concerts held in 2016 who are over 30 years old?
ideal_sql: WITH filtered_singers AS (SELECT `Singer_ID`, `Name` FROM `singer` WHERE `Age` > 30) SELECT fs.`Name` FROM filtered_singers fs JOIN `singer_in_concert` sic ON fs.`Singer_ID` = sic.`Singer_ID` WHERE sic.`concert_ID` IN (SELECT `concert_ID` FROM `singer_in_concert` WHERE `concert_ID` IS NOT NULL) AND fs.`Singer_ID` IS NOT NULL LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:account_user,account_userlog
user_question: Show the last login of superuser users with their log details.
ideal_sql: WITH superuser_logs AS (SELECT `account_user`.full_name, `account_userlog`.action, `account_userlog`.created_at FROM `account_user` JOIN `account_userlog` ON `account_user`.id = `account_userlog`.user_id WHERE `account_user`.is_superuser = 1) SELECT * FROM superuser_logs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:account_user,django_admin_log
user_question: Show users who have logged activity on a specific date with their full name and activity time.

title: icrl:with:account_user,account_userlog
user_question: Show users who have logged in at least once with their full name and the IP address of their last login.
ideal_sql: WITH last_login_info AS (SELECT `user_id`, MAX(`created_at`) AS last_login_time FROM `account_userlog` GROUP BY `user_id`) SELECT `au`.`full_name`, `lli`.`last_login_time`, `aul`.`ip_address` FROM `account_user` AS `au` JOIN `last_login_info` AS `lli` ON `au`.`id` = `lli`.`user_id` JOIN `account_userlog` AS `aul` ON `lli`.`user_id` = `aul`.`user_id` AND `lli`.`last_login_time` = `aul`.`created_at` LIMIT 100

title: icrl:having:yearmonth

title: icrl:having:yearmonth

title: icrl:join:transactions_1k,yearmonth

ideal_sql: SELECT `yearmonth`.`CustomerID`, AVG(`transactions_1k`.`Amount`) AS `AverageAmount` FROM `transactions_1k` JOIN `yearmonth` ON `transactions_1k`.`CustomerID` = `yearmonth`.`CustomerID` WHERE `yearmonth`.`Consumption` > 100 GROUP BY `yearmonth`.`CustomerID` HAVING COUNT(`transactions_1k`.`TransactionID`) > 3 AND AVG(`transactions_1k`.`Amount`) > 50 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:having:transactions_1k

ideal_sql: SELECT `Date`, COUNT(`TransactionID`) AS `TransactionCount` FROM `transactions_1k` GROUP BY `Date` HAVING COUNT(`TransactionID`) > 3 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:join:customers,yearmonth

ideal_sql: SELECT `customers`.`CustomerID`, AVG(`yearmonth`.`Consumption`) AS `AverageConsumption` FROM `customers` JOIN `yearmonth` ON `customers`.`CustomerID` = `yearmonth`.`CustomerID` WHERE `customers`.`Segment` = 'LAM' GROUP BY `customers`.`CustomerID` HAVING AVG(`yearmonth`.`Consumption`) > 30 AND AVG(`yearmonth`.`Consumption`) < 100 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:having:yearmonth
user_question: Calculate the number of customers whose consumption is more than 30 Toman based on month and year, and only display months and years where the number of customers is more than 5.
ideal_sql: SELECT YEAR(`Date`) AS year, MONTH(`Date`) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT `CustomerID`) AS customer_count FROM `yearmonth` WHERE `Consumption` > 30 GROUP BY year, month HAVING customer_count > 5 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:transactions_1k,yearmonth
user_question: What is the highest consumption amount of customers who had a transaction on 2012-08-25 and whose consumption is between 100 and 500?
ideal_sql: WITH filtered_customers AS (SELECT `CustomerID` FROM `transactions_1k` WHERE `Date` = '2012-08-25') SELECT MAX(`Consumption`) FROM `yearmonth` WHERE `CustomerID` IN (SELECT `CustomerID` FROM filtered_customers) AND `Consumption` BETWEEN 100 AND 500 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:customers,transactions_1k
user_question: What is the total amount of transactions for customers in the KAM sector who had a transaction on 2012-08-24, and is this amount greater than the total amount of transactions for customers in the B2B sector who had a transaction on the same date?
ideal_sql: WITH KAM_Transactions AS (SELECT SUM(`Amount`) AS TotalKAM FROM `transactions_1k` t JOIN `customers` c ON c.`CustomerID` = t.`CustomerID` WHERE c.`Segment` = 'KAM' AND t.`Date` = '2012-08-24'), B2B_Transactions AS (SELECT SUM(`Amount`) AS TotalB2B FROM `transactions_1k` t JOIN `customers` c ON c.`CustomerID` = t.`CustomerID` WHERE c.`Segment` = 'B2B' AND t.`Date` = '2012-08-24') SELECT (SELECT TotalKAM FROM KAM_Transactions) AS KAM_Total, (SELECT TotalB2B FROM B2B_Transactions) AS B2B_Total, (SELECT TotalKAM FROM KAM_Transactions) > (SELECT TotalB2B FROM B2B_Transactions) AS IsKAMGreater LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:gasstations,transactions_1k
user_question: Calculate the average transaction amount at fuel stations in the country CZE and also find the number of transactions that exceed this average.
ideal_sql: WITH avg_amount AS (SELECT AVG(Amount) AS average FROM `transactions_1k` t JOIN `gasstations` g ON g.`GasStationID` = t.`GasStationID` WHERE g.`Country` = 'CZE') SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_above_average FROM `transactions_1k` t JOIN `gasstations` g ON g.`GasStationID` = t.`GasStationID`, avg_amount a WHERE t.`Amount` > a.average AND g.`Country` = 'CZE' LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:products,transactions_1k

title: icrl:with:customers,yearmonth

ideal_sql: WITH AverageConsumption AS (SELECT AVG(Consumption) AS AvgConsumption FROM `yearmonth` JOIN `customers` ON `customers`.CustomerID = `yearmonth`.CustomerID WHERE `customers`.Segment = 'SME') SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `customers`.CustomerID) AS CustomerCount FROM `customers` JOIN `yearmonth` ON `customers`.CustomerID = `yearmonth`.CustomerID WHERE `customers`.Segment = 'SME' AND `yearmonth`.Consumption > (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM AverageConsumption) LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:customers,gasstations
user_question: How many customers are in the LAM sector and are located at fuel stations with chain 2?
ideal_sql: WITH filtered_customers AS (SELECT `CustomerID` FROM `customers` WHERE `Segment` = 'LAM'), filtered_gasstations AS (SELECT `GasStationID` FROM `gasstations` WHERE `ChainID` = 2) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fc.`CustomerID`) FROM filtered_customers fc JOIN filtered_gasstations fg ON fg.`GasStationID` = fc.`CustomerID` LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:gasstations,transactions_1k
user_question: Compare the total transaction amount at fuel stations with chain 3 with the total transaction amount at fuel stations with chain 1, considering only transactions that exceed 1000 units.
ideal_sql: WITH `Chain3Transactions` AS (SELECT SUM(`Amount`) AS `TotalAmount` FROM `transactions_1k` JOIN `gasstations` ON `gasstations`.`GasStationID` = `transactions_1k`.`GasStationID` WHERE `gasstations`.`ChainID` = 3 AND `transactions_1k`.`Amount` > 1000), `Chain1Transactions` AS (SELECT SUM(`Amount`) AS `TotalAmount` FROM `transactions_1k` JOIN `gasstations` ON `gasstations`.`GasStationID` = `transactions_1k`.`GasStationID` WHERE `gasstations`.`ChainID` = 1 AND `transactions_1k`.`Amount` > 1000) SELECT (SELECT `TotalAmount` FROM `Chain3Transactions`) AS `Chain3Total`, (SELECT `TotalAmount` FROM `Chain1Transactions`) AS `Chain1Total` LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:products,transactions_1k

title: icrl:with:gasstations,transactions_1k
user_question: I want to know how many transactions were made at fuel stations with chain 3 on the date 2012-08-23 and what the total amount of these transactions is.
ideal_sql: WITH `FilteredTransactions` AS (SELECT `GasStationID`, SUM(`Amount`) AS `TotalAmount` FROM `transactions_1k` WHERE `Date` = '2012-08-23' GROUP BY `GasStationID`) SELECT COUNT(*) AS `TransactionCount`, SUM(`TotalAmount`) AS `TotalSum` FROM `FilteredTransactions` INNER JOIN `gasstations` ON `FilteredTransactions`.`GasStationID` = `gasstations`.`GasStationID` WHERE `gasstations`.`ChainID` = 3 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:customers,yearmonth
user_question: I want to know how many customers are in the KAM sector whose consumption was greater than 100 between the dates 2012-01-01 and 2013-11-30.
ideal_sql: WITH filtered_customers AS (SELECT `CustomerID` FROM `customers` WHERE `Segment` = 'KAM'), consumption_data AS (SELECT `CustomerID`, SUM(`Consumption`) AS total_consumption FROM `yearmonth` WHERE `Date` BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2013-11-30' GROUP BY `CustomerID`) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM filtered_customers fc JOIN consumption_data cd ON fc.`CustomerID` = cd.`CustomerID` WHERE cd.total_consumption > 100 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:customers,transactions_1k

ideal_sql: WITH transaction_counts AS (SELECT `CustomerID`, COUNT(*) AS `TransactionCount` FROM `transactions_1k` WHERE `GasStationID` = 1155 GROUP BY `CustomerID` HAVING COUNT(*) > 2) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `c`.`CustomerID`) AS `CustomerCount` FROM `customers` AS `c` JOIN `transaction_counts` AS `tc` ON `c`.`CustomerID` = `tc`.`CustomerID` LIMIT 100

title: icrl:join:account,district

title: icrl:join:account,district

title: icrl:with:account,trans
user_question: Which accounts had transactions of type 'PRIJEM' in the year 1995 and a balance greater than 1000?
ideal_sql: WITH filtered_accounts AS (SELECT `account_id` FROM `account` WHERE YEAR(`date`) = 1995) SELECT DISTINCT `trans`.`account_id` FROM `trans` JOIN filtered_accounts ON `trans`.`account_id` = filtered_accounts.`account_id` WHERE `trans`.`type` = 'PRIJEM' AND `trans`.`balance` > 1000 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:account,disp
user_question: Display customers who have at least two accounts with a frequency of 'POPLATEK TYDNE' or make a comparison between the number of their accounts in districts with IDs above 100 and below 50.
ideal_sql: WITH account_counts AS (SELECT `disp`.`client_id`, COUNT(`account`.`account_id`) AS `account_count` FROM `disp` JOIN `account` ON `disp`.`account_id` = `account`.`account_id` WHERE `account`.`frequency` = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' GROUP BY `disp`.`client_id` HAVING COUNT(`account`.`account_id`) >= 2) SELECT `disp`.`client_id`, COUNT(`account`.`account_id`) AS `total_accounts` FROM `disp` JOIN `account` ON `disp`.`account_id` = `account`.`account_id` WHERE `account`.`district_id` > 100 OR `account`.`district_id` < 50 GROUP BY `disp`.`client_id` HAVING COUNT(`account`.`account_id`) > 0 OR `disp`.`client_id` IN (SELECT `client_id` FROM `account_counts`) LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:account,order
user_question: What accounts had at least one order with an amount less than 2000 in the year 1994 and their frequency is 'POPLATEK MESICNE'?
ideal_sql: WITH filtered_accounts AS (SELECT `account_id` FROM `account` WHERE `frequency` = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND YEAR(`date`) = 1994) SELECT DISTINCT `a`.`account_id` FROM filtered_accounts `a` JOIN `order` `o` ON `a`.`account_id` = `o`.`account_id` WHERE `o`.`amount` < 2000 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:client,district
user_question: Which regions have customers with birth dates between 1970 and 1980 and have more than 5 customers?
ideal_sql: WITH customer_counts AS (SELECT `district_id`, COUNT(*) AS `customer_count` FROM `client` WHERE `birth_date` BETWEEN '1970-01-01' AND '1980-12-31' GROUP BY `district_id`) SELECT `district`.`A2`, `district`.`A3` FROM `district` JOIN customer_counts ON `district`.`district_id` = customer_counts.`district_id` WHERE customer_counts.`customer_count` > 5 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:account,trans
user_question: Which accounts had transactions of type 'VYBER' in 1996 and a balance of less than 900, and the total amount of their transactions is more than 5000?
ideal_sql: WITH filtered_trans AS (SELECT `account_id`, SUM(`amount`) AS total_amount FROM `trans` WHERE `date` BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' AND `type` = 'VYBER' GROUP BY `account_id` HAVING total_amount > 5000) SELECT DISTINCT `a`.`account_id` FROM `account` `a` JOIN filtered_trans `ft` ON `a`.`account_id` = `ft`.`account_id` JOIN `trans` `t` ON `a`.`account_id` = `t`.`account_id` WHERE `t`.`date` BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' AND `t`.`type` = 'VYBER' AND `t`.`balance` < 900 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:account,order
user_question: Which accounts have at least two orders with an amount greater than 1500 and were created before 1995?
ideal_sql: WITH filtered_orders AS (SELECT `account_id` FROM `order` WHERE `amount` > 1500 GROUP BY `account_id` HAVING COUNT(`order_id`) >= 2) SELECT `a`.`account_id`, `a`.`district_id`, `a`.`frequency`, `a`.`date` FROM `account` AS `a` JOIN `filtered_orders` AS `fo` ON `a`.`account_id` = `fo`.`account_id` WHERE `a`.`date` < '1995-01-01' LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:disp,loan
user_question: Which customers have at least one loan with status 'A' and the loan date is between 1994 and 1996, and also the total amount of their loans is more than 10000 dollars?
ideal_sql: WITH filtered_loans AS (SELECT `account_id`, SUM(`amount`) AS total_amount FROM `loan` WHERE `status` = 'A' AND `date` BETWEEN '1994-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' GROUP BY `account_id` HAVING total_amount > 10000) SELECT DISTINCT `disp`.`client_id` FROM `disp` JOIN filtered_loans ON `disp`.`account_id` = filtered_loans.`account_id` LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:account,district
user_question: Which regions have accounts with frequency 'POPLATEK TYDNE' and the account creation dates are between 1993 and 1995?
ideal_sql: WITH filtered_accounts AS (SELECT * FROM `account` WHERE `frequency` = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' AND `date` BETWEEN '1993-01-01' AND '1995-12-31') SELECT DISTINCT `district`.* FROM `district` JOIN filtered_accounts ON `district`.`district_id` = `filtered_accounts`.`district_id` LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:client,disp
user_question: Please provide a list of customers who have at least one account of type 'OWNER' and their birth dates are between 1970 and 1980.
ideal_sql: WITH owner_clients AS (SELECT DISTINCT `client_id` FROM `disp` WHERE `type` = 'OWNER') SELECT `client`.`client_id`, `client`.`gender`, `client`.`birth_date`, `client`.`district_id` FROM `client` JOIN owner_clients ON `client`.`client_id` = owner_clients.`client_id` WHERE `client`.`birth_date` BETWEEN '1970-01-01' AND '1980-12-31' LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:client,district
user_question: In which regions is the number of customers with gender 'F' greater than the number of customers with gender 'M'?
ideal_sql: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT `district`.`district_id`, SUM(CASE WHEN `client`.`gender` = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_count, SUM(CASE WHEN `client`.`gender` = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_count FROM `client` JOIN `district` ON `client`.`district_id` = `district`.`district_id` GROUP BY `district`.`district_id`) SELECT `district_id` FROM `gender_counts` WHERE `female_count` > `male_count` LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:card,disp
user_question: Please display all accounts that have more than one representative and their card type is specified.
ideal_sql: WITH representative_counts AS (SELECT `disp`.`account_id`, COUNT(`disp`.`disp_id`) AS `rep_count` FROM `disp` GROUP BY `disp`.`account_id` HAVING COUNT(`disp`.`disp_id`) > 1) SELECT `card`.`card_id`, `card`.`type`, `card`.`issued` FROM `card` JOIN `disp` ON `card`.`disp_id` = `disp`.`disp_id` JOIN `representative_counts` ON `disp`.`account_id` = `representative_counts`.`account_id` WHERE `card`.`type` IS NOT NULL LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:client,district
user_question: Which regions have customers with birth dates before 1950 and have more than 10 customers, and also the number of customers with birth dates between 1950 and 1960 is less than 5?
ideal_sql: WITH client_counts AS (SELECT `district_id`, COUNT(*) AS `total_clients`, SUM(CASE WHEN `birth_date` < '1950-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `clients_before_1950`, SUM(CASE WHEN `birth_date` >= '1950-01-01' AND `birth_date` < '1960-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `clients_1950_1960` FROM `client` GROUP BY `district_id`) SELECT `district`.`district_id`, `district`.`A2` FROM `district` JOIN `client_counts` ON `district`.`district_id` = `client_counts`.`district_id` WHERE `clients_before_1950` > 10 AND `clients_1950_1960` < 5 LIMIT 100

ideal_sql: SELECT COUNT(`posthistory`.`Id`) AS `تعداد_تغییرات`, `badges`.`UserId` FROM `badges` JOIN `posthistory` ON `badges`.`UserId` = `posthistory`.`UserId` WHERE `badges`.`Name` = 'Editor' GROUP BY `badges`.`UserId` HAVING COUNT(`posthistory`.`Id`) > 10

title: icrl:having:comments
user_question: Calculate the average rating of comments for each post and display only those posts that have an average rating greater than 1 and less than 2, also calculate the number of comments for each post and only consider posts that have more than 5 comments.
ideal_sql: SELECT `PostId`, AVG(`Score`) AS `AverageScore`, COUNT(`Id`) AS `CommentCount` FROM `comments` GROUP BY `PostId` HAVING AVG(`Score`) > 1 AND AVG(`Score`) < 2 AND COUNT(`Id`) > 5 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:join:badges,votes

ideal_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS CommentCount FROM `votes` JOIN `badges` ON `badges`.`UserId` = `votes`.`UserId` WHERE `badges`.`Name` = 'Supporter' AND `votes`.`BountyAmount` > 50 AND `votes`.`BountyAmount` < 200

title: icrl:having:votes
user_question: Display the number of votes received by each type of vote within a specified time frame and only consider vote types that have more than 1000 votes.
ideal_sql: SELECT `VoteTypeId`, COUNT(*) AS `VoteCount` FROM `votes` WHERE `CreationDate` BETWEEN '2010-07-19' AND '2011-05-01' GROUP BY `VoteTypeId` HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:join:comments,postlinks
user_question: Calculate what the average rating of comments for each post is and only display posts that have comment ratings greater than 0 and less than 2, and also have more than 5 comments.
ideal_sql: SELECT `postlinks`.`PostId`, AVG(`comments`.`Score`) AS `AverageScore` FROM `comments` JOIN `postlinks` ON `comments`.`CreationDate` = `postlinks`.`CreationDate` GROUP BY `postlinks`.`PostId` HAVING AVG(`comments`.`Score`) > 0 AND AVG(`comments`.`Score`) < 2 AND COUNT(`comments`.`Id`) > 5 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:join:badges,comments
user_question: Calculate the number of comments submitted by users with the label "Editor" and only consider comments that have a rating of 1, also calculate the number of comments that have a rating of 5 and compare these two numbers.
ideal_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN `comments`.`Score` = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Count_Score_1`, SUM(CASE WHEN `comments`.`Score` = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Count_Score_5` FROM `badges` JOIN `comments` ON `badges`.`UserId` = `comments`.`UserId` WHERE `badges`.`Name` = 'Editor' LIMIT 100

title: icrl:having:comments
user_question: Calculate the number of comments submitted for posts with the ID 31038 and only display posts that have more than 20 comments and also have more than 50 likes.
ideal_sql: SELECT `PostId`, COUNT(*) AS `CommentCount` FROM `comments` WHERE `PostId` = 31038 GROUP BY `PostId` HAVING `CommentCount` > 20 AND SUM(`Score`) > 50 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:having:tags
user_question: Calculate the number of tags that have more than 2 occurrences and include 'analysis' in their name, and also calculate the number of tags that have between 1 and 2 occurrences and display the results comparatively.
ideal_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN `Count` > 2 THEN 'بیشتر از 2' WHEN `Count` BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'بین 1 و 2' END AS `محدوده`, COUNT(*) AS `تعداد` FROM `tags` WHERE `TagName` LIKE '%analysis%' GROUP BY `محدوده` HAVING `محدوده` IS NOT NULL LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:badges,comments
user_question: Which users with the badges 'Student' and 'Supporter' have registered the most comments in 2014 and have more than 10 comments?
ideal_sql: WITH UserBadges AS (SELECT `UserId` FROM `badges` WHERE `Name` IN ('Student', 'Supporter') AND `Date` BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2014-12-31') SELECT `comments`.`UserId`, COUNT(`comments`.`Id`) AS `CommentCount` FROM `comments` JOIN UserBadges ON `comments`.`UserId` = UserBadges.`UserId` GROUP BY `comments`.`UserId` HAVING COUNT(`comments`.`Id`) > 10 ORDER BY `CommentCount` DESC LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:badges,comments
user_question: Which users with the badge 'Editor' have earned the most comment scores in 2013 and have more than 5 comments?
ideal_sql: WITH UserBadges AS (SELECT `UserId` FROM `badges` WHERE `Name` = 'Editor' AND `Date` BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2013-12-31') SELECT `comments`.`UserId`, SUM(`comments`.`Score`) AS TotalScore FROM `comments` JOIN UserBadges ON `comments`.`UserId` = UserBadges.`UserId` GROUP BY `comments`.`UserId` HAVING COUNT(`comments`.`Id`) > 5 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:badges,comments
user_question: Which users with the badges 'Supporter' and 'Editor' have registered the most comments in 2012 and have an average comment score greater than 1?
ideal_sql: WITH UserComments AS (SELECT `badges`.`UserId`, COUNT(`comments`.`Id`) AS CommentCount, AVG(`comments`.`Score`) AS AverageScore FROM `badges` JOIN `comments` ON `badges`.`UserId` = `comments`.`UserId` WHERE `badges`.`Name` IN ('Supporter', 'Editor') AND YEAR(`comments`.`CreationDate`) = 2012 GROUP BY `badges`.`UserId`) SELECT `UserId` FROM UserComments WHERE CommentCount > 0 AND AverageScore > 1 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:badges,posthistory
user_question: Which users with the badge 'Student' have made the most edits in 2011 and have more than 3 edits?
ideal_sql: WITH UserEdits AS (SELECT `posthistory`.UserId, COUNT(*) AS EditCount FROM `posthistory` WHERE `posthistory`.CreationDate BETWEEN '2011-01-01' AND '2011-12-31' AND `posthistory`.PostHistoryTypeId = 2 GROUP BY `posthistory`.UserId) SELECT `badges`.UserId FROM `badges` JOIN UserEdits ON `badges`.UserId = UserEdits.UserId WHERE `badges`.Name = 'Student' AND UserEdits.EditCount > 3 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:badges,votes
user_question: Which users with the badges 'Student' and 'Editor' have received the most reward amount in 2010 and have a total reward greater than 100?
ideal_sql: WITH UserBadges AS (SELECT `UserId`, SUM(`BountyAmount`) AS TotalBounty FROM `votes` WHERE `CreationDate` BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-12-31' GROUP BY `UserId`) SELECT b.`UserId`, b.`Name` FROM `badges` b JOIN UserBadges ub ON b.`UserId` = ub.`UserId` WHERE b.`Name` IN ('Student', 'Editor') AND ub.TotalBounty > 100 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:posthistory,users
user_question: Which users with the badge 'Editor' have made the most edits in 2014 and have more than 5 edits, and also have more edits than the average number of edits of users with the badge 'Editor' in that year?
ideal_sql: WITH UserEdits AS (SELECT `UserId`, COUNT(*) AS EditCount FROM `posthistory` WHERE `CreationDate` BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2014-12-31' AND `PostHistoryTypeId` = 2 GROUP BY `UserId`), AverageEdits AS (SELECT AVG(EditCount) AS AvgEditCount FROM UserEdits) SELECT `u`.`DisplayName`, `ue`.`EditCount` FROM `UserEdits` AS `ue` JOIN `users` AS `u` ON `ue`.`UserId` = `u`.`Id` WHERE `ue`.`EditCount` > 5 HAVING `ue`.`EditCount` > (SELECT AvgEditCount FROM AverageEdits) LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:badges,posthistory
user_question: Which users with the badges 'Student' and 'Supporter' have made the most edits in 2012 and have a total of edits greater than 2, and also have more edits than the average edits of users with the same badges?
ideal_sql: WITH UserEdits AS (SELECT `badges`.`UserId`, COUNT(`posthistory`.`Id`) AS EditCount FROM `badges` JOIN `posthistory` ON `badges`.`UserId` = `posthistory`.`UserId` WHERE `badges`.`Name` IN ('Student', 'Supporter') AND YEAR(`posthistory`.`CreationDate`) = 2012 GROUP BY `badges`.`UserId` HAVING EditCount > 2) SELECT `UserId` FROM UserEdits WHERE EditCount > (SELECT AVG(EditCount) FROM UserEdits) LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:comments,posthistory
user_question: Which users with the badge 'Editor' have registered the most comments in 2013 and also have more than 2 edits?
ideal_sql: WITH UserComments AS (SELECT `UserId`, COUNT(*) AS CommentCount FROM `comments` WHERE YEAR(`CreationDate`) = 2013 GROUP BY `UserId` HAVING CommentCount > 2) SELECT ph.`UserId`, COUNT(*) AS EditCount FROM `posthistory` ph JOIN UserComments uc ON ph.`UserId` = uc.`UserId` WHERE ph.`PostHistoryTypeId` = 5 GROUP BY ph.`UserId` ORDER BY EditCount DESC LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:comments,posts
user_question: Which posts received the most comments with a score of 1 in 2014 and have more than 5 comments?
ideal_sql: WITH PostComments AS (SELECT `PostId`, COUNT(*) AS `CommentCount` FROM `comments` WHERE `Score` = 1 AND `CreationDate` BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2014-12-31' GROUP BY `PostId`) SELECT `p`.`Id`, `p`.`Title`, `pc`.`CommentCount` FROM `posts` AS `p` JOIN PostComments AS `pc` ON `p`.`Id` = `pc`.`PostId` WHERE `pc`.`CommentCount` > 5 LIMIT 100

ideal_sql: WITH pizza_expenses AS (SELECT `link_to_member` FROM `expense` WHERE `expense_description` = 'Pizza' AND `cost` > 20) SELECT SUM(`amount`) AS total_income FROM `income` WHERE `link_to_member` IN (SELECT `link_to_member` FROM pizza_expenses) LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:attendance,budget
user_question: How many events have remaining costs of less than 50 dollars and how many people have participated in these events? Also, consider only events that have at least 10 participants.
ideal_sql: WITH event_budget AS (SELECT `link_to_event`, SUM(`remaining`) AS total_remaining FROM `budget` WHERE `remaining` < 50 GROUP BY `link_to_event` HAVING COUNT(`link_to_event`) >= 10) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.`link_to_event`) AS event_count, COUNT(a.`link_to_member`) AS participant_count FROM `attendance` a JOIN event_budget eb ON a.`link_to_event` = eb.`link_to_event` LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:attendance,income,budget
user_question: What is the amount spent on events that have received income of more than 100 dollars?
ideal_sql: WITH event_income AS (SELECT `attendance`.`link_to_event`, SUM(`income`.`amount`) AS total_income FROM `attendance` JOIN `income` ON `attendance`.`link_to_member` = `income`.`link_to_member` GROUP BY `attendance`.`link_to_event` HAVING total_income > 100) SELECT SUM(`budget`.`spent`) FROM `budget` JOIN event_income ON `budget`.`link_to_event` = event_income.`link_to_event` LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:attendance,expense,income
user_question: How many members have participated in events where their food expenses are more than 10 dollars and less than 30 dollars, and what amount has been recorded for these members?
ideal_sql: WITH member_food_expenses AS (SELECT `attendance`.`link_to_member` FROM `attendance` JOIN `expense` ON `attendance`.`link_to_member` = `expense`.`link_to_member` WHERE `expense`.`expense_description` = 'Food' AND `expense`.`cost` > 10 AND `expense`.`cost` < 30) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `member_food_expenses`.`link_to_member`) AS member_count, SUM(`expense`.`cost`) AS total_expense FROM `member_food_expenses` JOIN `expense` ON `member_food_expenses`.`link_to_member` = `expense`.`link_to_member` LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:attendance,expense,income
user_question: With an intermediate query, how many rows are there in the join of «attendance» and «expense»?
ideal_sql: WITH linked AS (SELECT 1 AS x FROM attendance JOIN expense ON attendance.link_to_member = expense.link_to_member) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM linked

title: icrl:having:hero_attribute
user_question: Calculate the average feature values for each hero and only display heroes with an average above 30 and more than 5 features.
ideal_sql: SELECT `hero_id`, AVG(`attribute_value`) AS `average_attribute_value`, COUNT(`attribute_id`) AS `attribute_count` FROM `hero_attribute` GROUP BY `hero_id` HAVING AVG(`attribute_value`) > 30 AND COUNT(`attribute_id`) > 5 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:join:alignment,superhero
user_question: Show the number of heroes with each type of distinction where their count is greater than 5.
ideal_sql: SELECT `alignment`.`alignment`, COUNT(`superhero`.`id`) AS `hero_count` FROM `alignment` JOIN `superhero` ON `superhero`.`alignment_id` = `alignment`.`id` GROUP BY `alignment`.`alignment` HAVING COUNT(`superhero`.`id`) > 5 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:having:hero_attribute
user_question: Calculate the total feature values for each hero and only display heroes with a total above 100, also consider heroes with more than 5 features.
ideal_sql: SELECT `hero_id`, SUM(`attribute_value`) AS total_attribute_value, COUNT(`attribute_id`) AS attribute_count FROM `hero_attribute` GROUP BY `hero_id` HAVING total_attribute_value > 100 AND attribute_count > 5 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:having:publisher
user_question: Group the number of publishers by publisher name and only display publishers with a count greater than 2, also calculate the number of publishers whose names contain the letter 'الف' and compare these two results.
ideal_sql: SELECT `publisher_name`, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM `publisher` GROUP BY `publisher_name` HAVING `count` > 2 UNION SELECT 'ناشرانی با حرف الف', COUNT(*) FROM `publisher` WHERE `publisher_name` LIKE '%الف%' LIMIT 100

title: icrl:having:attribute
user_question: Calculate the number of different features for each type of feature and only display features with a count greater than 2, also consider features with a count less than 10 and display the total of these two groups as a new record.
ideal_sql: SELECT `attribute_name`, COUNT(*) as `count` FROM `attribute` GROUP BY `attribute_name` HAVING `count` > 2 OR `count` < 10 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:join:attribute,hero_attribute
user_question: Calculate the average of features and display the number of features whose average is between 30 and 50.
ideal_sql: SELECT AVG(`hero_attribute`.`attribute_value`) AS average_value, COUNT(*) AS count_above_30 FROM `hero_attribute` JOIN `attribute` ON `hero_attribute`.`attribute_id` = `attribute`.`id` GROUP BY `attribute`.`id` HAVING average_value BETWEEN 30 AND 50 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:having:hero_attribute
user_question: Calculate the maximum feature values for each hero and only display heroes with a maximum above 80.
ideal_sql: SELECT `hero_id`, MAX(`attribute_value`) AS max_attribute_value FROM `hero_attribute` GROUP BY `hero_id` HAVING max_attribute_value > 80 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:having:hero_attribute
user_question: Calculate the minimum feature values for each hero and only display heroes with a minimum below 30.
ideal_sql: SELECT `hero_id`, MIN(`attribute_value`) AS `min_attribute_value` FROM `hero_attribute` GROUP BY `hero_id` HAVING `min_attribute_value` < 30 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:having:colour
user_question: Calculate the number of different colors that have a count greater than 3 and also display the number of colors that have a count less than 10, and only display colors that fall into these two categories.
ideal_sql: SELECT `colour`, COUNT(*) as `count` FROM `colour` GROUP BY `colour` HAVING `count` > 3 OR `count` < 10 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:having:alignment
user_question: Group the number of different distinctions by type of distinction and only display distinctions with a count greater than 1, also consider distinctions with a count less than 50 and display them in a separate subset.
ideal_sql: SELECT `alignment`, COUNT(*) as `count` FROM `alignment` GROUP BY `alignment` HAVING `count` > 1 OR `count` < 50 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:join:hero_attribute,hero_power
user_question: Calculate the average feature values for each hero and only display heroes with an average above 30 and more than 2 powers.
ideal_sql: SELECT `hero_attribute`.`hero_id`, AVG(`hero_attribute`.`attribute_value`) AS average_attribute_value FROM `hero_attribute` JOIN `hero_power` ON `hero_attribute`.`hero_id` = `hero_power`.`hero_id` GROUP BY `hero_attribute`.`hero_id` HAVING average_attribute_value > 30 AND COUNT(`hero_power`.`power_id`) > 2 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:having:superhero

ideal_sql: SELECT `superhero_name`, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM `superhero` GROUP BY `superhero_name` HAVING `count` > 3 AND `count` < 10 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:group:superpower
user_question: How many rows do we have by 'power_name'?

title: icrl:with:alignment,superhero
user_question: How many superheroes are in good condition and what are their full names?
ideal_sql: WITH good_superheroes AS (SELECT `superhero`.`full_name` FROM `superhero` JOIN `alignment` ON `superhero`.`alignment_id` = `alignment`.`id` WHERE `alignment`.`alignment` = 'Good') SELECT COUNT(*) AS `count`, GROUP_CONCAT(`full_name` SEPARATOR ', ') AS `names` FROM good_superheroes LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:attribute,hero_attribute
user_question: I want to know how many superheroes have intelligence and power attributes and what are the values of these attributes?
ideal_sql: WITH hero_attributes AS (SELECT `hero_id`, `attribute_id`, `attribute_value` FROM `hero_attribute` WHERE `attribute_id` IN (SELECT `id` FROM `attribute` WHERE `attribute_name` IN ('Intelligence', 'Strength'))) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `hero_id`) AS `hero_count`, SUM(`attribute_value`) AS `total_value` FROM hero_attributes LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:gender,superhero
user_question: How many male superheroes are there and what are their names?
ideal_sql: WITH male_superheroes AS (SELECT `superhero`.`full_name` FROM `superhero` JOIN `gender` ON `superhero`.`gender_id` = `gender`.`id` WHERE `gender`.`gender` = 'Male') SELECT COUNT(*) AS `count`, GROUP_CONCAT(`full_name` SEPARATOR ', ') AS `names` FROM male_superheroes LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:hero_attribute,hero_power
user_question: Show the highest power of each attribute for heroes with high power.
ideal_sql: WITH high_power_heroes AS (SELECT `hero_power`.`hero_id` FROM `hero_power` GROUP BY `hero_power`.`hero_id` HAVING COUNT(`hero_power`.`power_id`) > 2) SELECT `hero_attribute`.`attribute_value`, COUNT(`high_power_heroes`.`hero_id`) AS hero_count FROM `hero_attribute` JOIN high_power_heroes ON `hero_attribute`.`hero_id` = `high_power_heroes`.`hero_id` GROUP BY `hero_attribute`.`attribute_value` HAVING hero_count > 1 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:alignment,superhero
user_question: Can I see a list of superheroes whose condition is bad and whose height is more than 180 centimeters?
ideal_sql: WITH BadSuperheroes AS (SELECT `superhero`.full_name, `superhero`.height_cm FROM `superhero` JOIN `alignment` ON `superhero`.alignment_id = `alignment`.id WHERE `alignment`.alignment = 'Bad' AND `superhero`.height_cm > 180) SELECT * FROM BadSuperheroes LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:alignment,superhero
user_question: How does the average height of neutral superheroes taller than 170 centimeters compare to the height of neutral superheroes shorter than 170 centimeters?
ideal_sql: WITH `neutral_superheroes_above_170` AS (SELECT AVG(`height_cm`) AS `avg_height_above_170` FROM `superhero` INNER JOIN `alignment` ON `superhero`.`alignment_id` = `alignment`.`id` WHERE `alignment`.`alignment` = 'neutral' AND `superhero`.`height_cm` > 170), `neutral_superheroes_below_170` AS (SELECT AVG(`height_cm`) AS `avg_height_below_170` FROM `superhero` INNER JOIN `alignment` ON `superhero`.`alignment_id` = `alignment`.`id` WHERE `alignment`.`alignment` = 'neutral' AND `superhero`.`height_cm` < 170) SELECT `avg_height_above_170`, `avg_height_below_170` FROM `neutral_superheroes_above_170`, `neutral_superheroes_below_170` LIMIT 100

title: icrl:having:examination

ideal_sql: SELECT `ANA Pattern`, COUNT(*) AS `Number of Tests` FROM `examination` GROUP BY `ANA Pattern` HAVING `Number of Tests` BETWEEN 10 AND 50 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:having:examination
user_question: Group the average values of aCL IgG based on diagnosis and only display diagnoses that have an average greater than 0.5 and also have fewer than 50 samples for each diagnosis.
ideal_sql: SELECT `Diagnosis`, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS `average_aCL_IgG`, COUNT(*) AS `sample_count` FROM `examination` GROUP BY `Diagnosis` HAVING `average_aCL_IgG` > 0.5 AND `sample_count` < 50 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:having:laboratory
user_question: Group the average values of GOT based on date and only display dates that have an average greater than 17 and also consider dates that have an average ALP less than 100.
ideal_sql: SELECT `Date`, AVG(`GOT`) AS `Average_GOT`, COUNT(*) AS `Record_Count` FROM `laboratory` GROUP BY `Date` HAVING AVG(`GOT`) > 17 AND COUNT(*) < 50 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:having:patient
user_question: Group the number of patients based on gender and age and only display genders that have more than 300 patients and the average age of patients in those genders is greater than 40 years.
ideal_sql: SELECT `SEX`, COUNT(*) AS `count`, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, `Birthday`, CURDATE())) AS `average_age` FROM `patient` GROUP BY `SEX` HAVING `count` > 300 AND `average_age` > 40 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:having:laboratory
user_question: Group the average values of ALP based on date and only display dates that have an average greater than 75 and also consider dates that have an average ALP less than 100.
ideal_sql: SELECT `Date`, AVG(`ALP`) as `average_ALP` FROM `laboratory` GROUP BY `Date` HAVING AVG(`ALP`) > 75 AND AVG(`ALP`) < 100 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:having:examination
user_question: Group the number of tests based on diagnosis and only display diagnoses that have more than 100 tests and also consider the number of tests for diagnoses related to the age group over 60 years.
ideal_sql: SELECT `Diagnosis`, COUNT(*) AS `Total_Examinations`, SUM(CASE WHEN `Examination Date` < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 60 YEAR) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Examinations_Above_60` FROM `examination` GROUP BY `Diagnosis` HAVING `Total_Examinations` > 100 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:join:examination,patient
user_question: Group the number of patients based on diagnosis and only display diagnoses that have more than 50 patients and also consider the number of patients with specific diagnoses that are between the ages of 30 and 40 years, which should be more than 20.
ideal_sql: SELECT `examination`.`Diagnosis`, COUNT(`patient`.`ID`) AS `PatientCount` FROM `examination` JOIN `patient` ON `examination`.`Diagnosis` = `patient`.`Diagnosis` GROUP BY `examination`.`Diagnosis` HAVING COUNT(`patient`.`ID`) > 50 AND SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(`patient`.`Birthday`) BETWEEN 30 AND 40 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 20 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:having:bond
user_question: Group the number of bonds by bond type and display only those bond types that have more than 50 bonds. Also, calculate the number of bonds for bond types that have between 50 and 100, and compare these two groups.
ideal_sql: SELECT `bond_type`, COUNT(`bond_id`) AS `count` FROM `bond` GROUP BY `bond_type` HAVING `count` > 50 OR (`count` BETWEEN 50 AND 100) LIMIT 100

title: icrl:join:bond,connected
user_question: Display the number of atoms connected to bonds of type '=' and also calculate the number of atoms connected to bonds of type '≠' and compare these two values.
ideal_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN `bond`.`bond_type` = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS equal_bonds, SUM(CASE WHEN `bond`.`bond_type` = '≠' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_equal_bonds FROM `bond` JOIN `connected` ON `connected`.`bond_id` = `bond`.`bond_id` LIMIT 100

title: icrl:having:molecule
user_question: Group the number of molecules by label and display only those labels that have more than 100 and less than 500.
ideal_sql: SELECT `label`, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM `molecule` GROUP BY `label` HAVING `count` > 100 AND `count` < 500 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:filter:connected
user_question: Display the number of atoms connected to atoms TR466_2 and TR496_27.
ideal_sql: SELECT `atom_id2`, COUNT(`atom_id`) AS `count` FROM `connected` WHERE `atom_id2` IN ('TR466_2', 'TR496_27') GROUP BY `atom_id2` LIMIT 100

title: icrl:join:atom,bond
user_question: Compare the number of atoms connected to bonds of type '#' with the number of atoms connected to bonds of type '='.
ideal_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN `bond`.`bond_type` = '#' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_hash_bonds, SUM(CASE WHEN `bond`.`bond_type` = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_equal_bonds FROM `atom` JOIN `bond` ON `atom`.`molecule_id` = `bond`.`molecule_id` LIMIT 100

title: icrl:join:atom,bond
user_question: Display the number of atoms connected to bonds of type '-'.
ideal_sql: SELECT COUNT(`atom`.`atom_id`) AS `atom_count` FROM `atom` JOIN `bond` ON `atom`.`molecule_id` = `bond`.`molecule_id` WHERE `bond`.`bond_type` = '-'

title: icrl:join:bond,molecule
user_question: Group the number of bonds by bond type and display only those bond types that have more than 200 bonds and also have fewer than 50 bonds of type "covalent".
ideal_sql: SELECT `bond_type`, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM `bond` JOIN `molecule` ON `bond`.`molecule_id` = `molecule`.`molecule_id` GROUP BY `bond_type` HAVING COUNT(*) > 200 AND SUM(CASE WHEN `bond_type` = 'کوالان' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 50 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:join:atom,molecule
user_question: Compare the number of atoms connected to molecules with label '+' with the number of atoms connected to molecules with label '-'.
ideal_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN `molecule`.`label` = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `positive_atoms`, SUM(CASE WHEN `molecule`.`label` = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `negative_atoms` FROM `atom` JOIN `molecule` ON `atom`.`molecule_id` = `molecule`.`molecule_id` LIMIT 100

title: icrl:join:atom,connected
user_question: Display the number of atoms connected to atoms of type 'h' and 'c' that each have more than 2 connected atoms.
ideal_sql: SELECT `atom`.`element`, COUNT(`connected`.`atom_id2`) AS `connected_count` FROM `atom` JOIN `connected` ON `connected`.`atom_id` = `atom`.`atom_id` WHERE `atom`.`element` IN ('h', 'c') GROUP BY `atom`.`element` HAVING COUNT(`connected`.`atom_id2`) > 2 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:join:atom,connected
user_question: Compare the number of atoms connected to atoms of type 'o' with the number of atoms connected to atoms of type 'h'.
ideal_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN `a`.`element` = 'o' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `count_o`, SUM(CASE WHEN `a`.`element` = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `count_h` FROM `atom` AS `a` JOIN `connected` AS `c` ON `c`.`atom_id` = `a`.`atom_id` LIMIT 100

title: icrl:join:atom,molecule
user_question: How many rows are related to the connection between «atom» and «molecule»?
ideal_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id

title: icrl:join:bond,molecule
user_question: How many rows are related to the connection of «bond» and «molecule»?
ideal_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM bond JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id

title: icrl:with:atom,bond
user_question: Which elements have the most types of bonds in different molecules and have a number of bonds greater than a specified value?
ideal_sql: WITH ElementBondTypeCount AS (SELECT `atom`.`element`, COUNT(DISTINCT `bond`.`bond_type`) AS bond_type_count FROM `atom` JOIN `bond` ON `atom`.`molecule_id` = `bond`.`molecule_id` GROUP BY `atom`.`element` HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT `bond`.`bond_type`) > 1) SELECT `element`, bond_type_count FROM ElementBondTypeCount WHERE bond_type_count = (SELECT MAX(bond_type_count) FROM ElementBondTypeCount) LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:atom,bond
user_question: Which elements exist with a specific type of bond in different molecules and have a count greater than 5?
ideal_sql: WITH ElementBondCount AS (SELECT `atom`.`element`, COUNT(`bond`.`bond_id`) AS bond_count FROM `atom` JOIN `bond` ON `atom`.`molecule_id` = `bond`.`molecule_id` GROUP BY `atom`.`element`) SELECT `element` FROM ElementBondCount WHERE bond_count > 5 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:atom,molecule
user_question: Which molecules have a positive label and have more than 2 hydrogen atoms?
ideal_sql: WITH hydrogen_atoms AS (SELECT `molecule_id` FROM `atom` WHERE `element` = 'H' GROUP BY `molecule_id` HAVING COUNT(*) > 2) SELECT `molecule`.`label` FROM `molecule` JOIN hydrogen_atoms ON `molecule`.`molecule_id` = hydrogen_atoms.`molecule_id` LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:atom,bond,connected
user_question: Which atoms are connected to other atoms and have a specific type of bond, with the number of bonds connected to each atom being greater than a specific number?
ideal_sql: WITH joined_data AS (SELECT `atom`.`atom_id`, `atom`.`element`, `bond`.`bond_type` FROM `atom` JOIN `bond` ON `atom`.`molecule_id` = `bond`.`molecule_id`) SELECT `joined_data`.`atom_id`, `joined_data`.`element`, `joined_data`.`bond_type`, COUNT(`connected`.`atom_id2`) AS `connected_count` FROM `joined_data` JOIN `connected` ON `joined_data`.`atom_id` = `connected`.`atom_id` WHERE `joined_data`.`bond_type` = '-' GROUP BY `joined_data`.`atom_id`, `joined_data`.`element`, `joined_data`.`bond_type` HAVING COUNT(`connected`.`atom_id2`) > 1 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:atom,connected
user_question: Which atoms are connected to other atoms in different molecules and have a specific type of bond, with the number of atoms connected to each atom being greater than 3?
ideal_sql: WITH atom_connections AS (SELECT `atom`.`atom_id`, COUNT(`connected`.`atom_id2`) AS connection_count FROM `atom` JOIN `connected` ON `connected`.`atom_id` = `atom`.`atom_id` GROUP BY `atom`.`atom_id`) SELECT `atom`.`element`, `atom_connections`.`connection_count` FROM `atom` JOIN `atom_connections` ON `atom`.`atom_id` = `atom_connections`.`atom_id` WHERE `atom_connections`.`connection_count` > 3 LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:atom,molecule,bond
user_question: Which atoms belong to molecules that have a positive label and have more than 3 bonds?
ideal_sql: WITH molecule_bonds AS (SELECT `molecule`.`molecule_id`, COUNT(`bond`.`bond_id`) AS bond_count FROM `molecule` JOIN `bond` ON `molecule`.`molecule_id` = `bond`.`molecule_id` GROUP BY `molecule`.`molecule_id` HAVING COUNT(`bond`.`bond_id`) > 3) SELECT `atom`.`atom_id` FROM `atom` JOIN molecule_bonds ON `atom`.`molecule_id` = molecule_bonds.`molecule_id` JOIN `molecule` ON `molecule`.`molecule_id` = molecule_bonds.`molecule_id` WHERE `molecule`.`label` = '+' LIMIT 100

title: icrl:with:bond,connected,molecule
user_question: With an intermediate query, how many rows are there for the connection of «connected» and «bond»?
ideal_sql: WITH linked AS (SELECT 1 AS x FROM connected JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM linked
